start: A member sent a help question the AI could not answer; HQ open

user_sees: The card flagged 'Needs reply' with time, 'Member app', 'gym <code>' and the screen
must_not: A message from one gym shown with another gym's code

steps.action: Type a reply in the box ('Your reply. The person reads it in the app’s Help and feedback.') and tap 'Send reply'
user_sees: 'Sent. Their phone got a pop-up.' or 'Sent. They see it the next time they open the app.'
must_not: A pop-up to a phone that left no push address

steps.action: Pick 'Done' in the status box, type a note ('Note (only you see it)'), tap 'Save'
must_not: The note shown to the member
The status saved on another message

start: Needs you shows help questions waiting

steps.action: Tap the line for help questions on 'Needs you'
user_sees: Feedback opens with 'Show' set to 'Needs reply'
must_not: Messages already replied to in the list

user_sees: 'Rewritten. Nothing is sent yet: check it, change anything, then tap Send reply. Undo brings your own words back.'
must_not: The rewritten text sent to the member before Send reply

start: Feedback page, a help question card

steps.action: Type one letter and tap 'Send reply'
must_not: A one-letter reply saved and pushed

user_sees: 'No question is waiting for a reply.'
must_not: An empty page with no words

steps.action: Tap 'Save' on a message the nightly clean-up removed a moment ago
user_sees: 'That gym or request is not there any more. The page was refreshed.'
must_not: 'Saved.' for a change that was not made

start: A plain feedback message with status new

user_sees: Needs you new-feedback count one lower
must_not: The count unchanged after the save
A spam message still counted as waiting for a reply

start: A member's help question with phone model and screen

user_sees: The text, app, device, screen and gym code the member sent
must_not: The message shown to the gym or its trainers through HQ

user_sees: Only this one question and the draft go to Google; the Log keeps tokens and cost, not the words
must_not: The question text written into the Log
